objective: Implement a deterministic point-in-time macro surprise engine using P10-C revision-zero first release actuals and separately evidenced pre-release consensus snapshots without interpreting raw surprise as market direction or trade probability.
scope: Require explicit consensus provider identity, method, sample size, observed-at timestamp and evidence hashes
Require consensus observation strictly before revision-zero release time
Require consensus series and unit to match P10-C first-release actual
Use P10-C revision-zero value as actual
Compute exact Decimal raw surprise actual minus consensus
Classify only ABOVE_CONSENSUS, BELOW_CONSENSUS or AT_CONSENSUS
Preserve P10-C history ID, actual vintage ID, previous-at-first-release vintage ID and consensus fingerprint
out_of_scope: Production consensus provider selection or credentials
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P10-D source/tests
Consensus snapshot Decimal values are finite
Consensus method is explicitly MEDIAN or MEAN
Consensus sample size is at least two
Consensus observed-at is strictly before first-release release time
Consensus series and unit match P10-C first release
Actual is exactly P10-C revision-zero value
Raw surprise equals actual minus consensus with Decimal arithmetic
Direction is descriptive only: ABOVE_CONSENSUS / BELOW_CONSENSUS / AT_CONSENSUS
Later revisions cannot change first-release surprise
Consensus identity and surprise identity are deterministic/content-sensitive
P10-D evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No network or credential access required
rollback: Revert P10-D macro-surprise contract/policy/tests/evidence/CI/state. P10-A/B/C remain canonical and no trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Consensus and raw surprise contracts implemented
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
